method: Pitch pairs were checked against the cited notated editions. Copyrighted works use interval-only playback; no commercial recordings or MIDI files are included.

references.title: Jingle Bells
references.location: Chorus, first two notes of ‘Jingle bells’

description.en: Repeated notes at the start of the chorus.
description.no: Gjentatte toner i starten av refrenget.

references.title: One Note Samba
references.location: Opening vocal phrase, first two notes (G-major lead-sheet convention)

description.en: The opening phrase deliberately repeats D in the cited lead-sheet key; other editions transpose it.
description.no: Åpningsfrasen gjentar D i tonearten til den oppgitte lead sheet-utgaven; andre utgaver transponerer den.

references.title: Theme from Jaws
references.location: Main ostinato motif

description.en: The main motif alternates two adjacent semitones.
description.no: Hovedmotivet veksler mellom to nabotoner.

references.title: Für Elise
references.location: Opening, first two melody notes

description.en: The famous opening begins with a descending semitone.
description.no: Den kjente åpningen starter med en nedadgående halvtone.

references.title: Happy Birthday to You
references.location: Opening phrase, second to third note

description.en: The first upward step in the opening phrase is a major second.
description.no: Det første trinnet opp i åpningsfrasen er en stor sekund.

references.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
references.location: Opening, first two notes

description.en: The melody opens by stepping down a major second.
description.no: Melodien åpner med en stor sekund ned.

references.title: Greensleeves
references.location: Opening pickup to first strong melody note

description.en: The opening pickup rises a minor third.
description.no: Opptakten stiger en liten ters.

references.title: Hey Jude
references.location: Opening words ‘Hey Jude’ in the original key

description.en: The title words outline a descending minor third.
description.no: Tittelordene danner en liten ters ned.

references.title: When the Saints Go Marching In
references.location: Opening, first two distinct melody pitches

description.en: The opening rises from the tonic to the major third.
description.no: Åpningen går fra grunntonen opp til den store tersen.

references.title: Symphony No. 5
references.location: Opening motif, third to fourth note

description.en: The fourth note of the famous opening motif drops from G to E-flat, a major third.
description.no: Den fjerde tonen i det kjente åpningsmotivet faller fra G til Ess, en stor ters.

references.title: Bridal Chorus (Here Comes the Bride)
references.location: Opening melodic leap

description.en: The familiar wedding melody opens with an ascending perfect fourth.
description.no: Den kjente bryllupsmelodien åpner med en ren kvart opp.

references.title: O Come, All Ye Faithful
references.location: Opening two notes, ‘O–come’, in the cited G-major hymn edition

description.en: The opening words ‘O–come’ descend from G to D; editions in other keys preserve the perfect fourth.
description.no: Åpningsordene «O–come» går fra G ned til D; utgaver i andre tonearter beholder den rene kvarten.

references.title: The Simpsons Theme
references.location: Opening title motif

description.en: The opening title motif features an ascending tritone.
description.no: Åpningsmotivet bruker en tritonus opp.

references.title: Black Sabbath
references.location: Main guitar riff, G to C-sharp

description.en: The main riff emphasizes a descending tritone.
description.no: Hovedriffet fremhever en tritonus ned.

references.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
references.location: Opening, second to third note

description.en: The first leap in the melody is a perfect fifth.
description.no: Det første spranget i melodien er en ren kvint.

references.title: Meet the Flintstones
references.attribution: Hoyt Curtin / Joseph Barbera / William Hanna
references.location: Opening two sung notes, ‘Flint–stones’, in Alfred’s Middle C arrangement

description.en: ‘Flint–stones’ descends from D above middle C to G below it in the cited edition.
description.no: «Flint–stones» går fra D over enstrøken C ned til G under i den oppgitte utgaven.

references.title: The Entertainer
references.location: First strain, E4→C5 after the D4–D♯4 pickup (bars 5–6 in the cited transcription)

description.en: The familiar first-strain figure repeatedly leaps from E4 up to C5.
description.no: Den kjente figuren i første del hopper flere ganger fra E4 opp til C5.

references.title: In My Life
references.location: Opening guitar figure, first melodic leap

description.en: The song’s opening guitar figure begins with C-sharp rising to A.
description.no: Gitarriffet i åpningen begynner med Ciss som stiger til A.

references.title: My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean
references.location: Opening pickup, ‘My’ to ‘Bonnie’

description.en: The opening pickup leaps upward a major sixth.
description.no: Opptakten i åpningen hopper en stor sekst opp.

references.title: Love Story (Where Do I Begin)
references.location: Opening two vocal notes, ‘Where–do’, in the cited A-minor arrangement

description.en: In this documented A-minor arrangement, ‘Where–do’ descends from A4 to C4: a major sixth, not a minor sixth.
description.no: I denne dokumenterte A-moll-utgaven går «Where–do» fra A4 ned til C4: en stor sekst, ikke en liten sekst.

references.title: Man in the Mirror
references.location: Beginning of the chorus, between ‘I’m’ and ‘start–’ (about 1:07 in the original recording)

description.en: The chorus entry ‘I’m start–’ descends a major sixth in the original key.
description.no: Inngangen til refrenget, «I’m start–», går en stor sekst ned i original toneart.

references.title: Somewhere (West Side Story)
references.location: Opening word ‘Somewhere’

description.en: The opening word spans an ascending minor seventh.
description.no: Åpningsordet spenner over en liten septim opp.

references.title: An American in Paris
references.location: Opening leap of the principal blues theme in the B section

description.en: The principal blues theme begins with B-flat descending to C in the octave below.
description.no: Det sentrale bluestemaet begynner med B♭ som går ned til C i oktaven under.

references.title: Take On Me
references.attribution: Magne Furuholmen / Morten Harket / Pål Waaktaar
references.location: Beginning of the chorus, between the words ‘Take–on’, in the original key

description.en: At the chorus entrance, ‘Take–on’ rises from A2 to G-sharp3 before resolving up to A3 on ‘me’.
description.no: Ved starten av refrenget går «Take–on» fra A2 opp til Giss3 før melodien løses opp til A3 på «me».

references.title: I Love You
references.location: Opening title phrase, between ‘I’ and ‘love’, in the cited C-major edition

description.en: The title phrase opens with B descending to C in the octave below.
description.no: Tittelfrasen åpner med B som går ned til C i oktaven under.

references.title: Over the Rainbow
references.location: Opening word ‘Some–where’ in Alfred’s Middle C arrangement

description.en: ‘Some–where’ rises from G below middle C to the G an octave above in the cited edition.
description.no: «Some–where» går fra G under enstrøken C opp til G en oktav høyere i den oppgitte utgaven.

references.title: Willow Weep for Me
references.location: Opening title phrase, between the first two syllables of ‘Willow’, in the original A-flat-major edition

description.en: The first two sung notes of ‘Willow’ descend from E-flat4 to E-flat3 in the cited original-key edition.
description.no: De to første sungne tonene i «Willow» går fra Ess4 ned til Ess3 i den oppgitte originaltonearten.
